verdict.rationale: A tax agency's e-services portal could plausibly offer user-defined automation, such as rule-triggered payments or actions, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only fixed CRA email notifications and manual e-services like filing, paying and submitting documents, with no user-configurable event-triggered rules. The email notifications are an adjacent feature, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
